channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: One killed, four injured in Thailand school shooting, officials say
item.description: Authorities say the gunman, a student, killed a teacher before taking his own life at a school northwest of Bangkok.

item.title: Brazil formally accuses 16 people over 2024 Voepass deadly plane crash
item.description: Official says plane was irregularly cleared for departure before crash that killed 62 people outside Sao Paulo.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says war can’t ‘go much longer’; Hormuz deal close
item.description: The US, Iran, and Oman are close to a temporary deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: ‘No red line’: South Lebanon residents outraged as Israel resumes strikes
item.description: People in southern Lebanon question their government's approach as Israel launches more attacks and displacement orders.

item.title: Iran’s Ghalibaf accuses Trump of conducting show diplomacy ‘on loop’
item.description: US president says he is involved in talks and war will end 'pretty soon', claiming that Iran cannot 'go much longer'.

item.title: Thousands of migrants still in Ceuta after border crisis, local leader says
item.description: The Spanish territory's mayor-president also says 100 deaths occurred as a result of 78,000 migrants crossing from neighbouring Morocco.

item.title: Israel charges settler over killing of Palestinian involved in Oscar-winning West Bank film
item.description: Yinon Levy is charged with reckless manslaughter over the July 2025 shooting of Odeh Hathaleen.

item.title: Rights groups say Israeli attack that killed Lebanese journalist an apparent war crime
item.description: Amal Khalil was killed and her colleague Zeinab Faraj wounded in an Israeli attack in April; Israel denied targeting the journalists.

item.title: Houthi attacks reportedly kill at least 30 Yemeni government forces
item.description: The Houthis say they launched missiles and drones at "Saudi military build-ups" in the central provinces of Marib and Hadramawt.

item.title: DR Congo river boat under quarantine for Ebola after five deaths
item.description: The health minister says all the passengers are being screened as a precautionary measure.
